question.html:
The initial activity of a radioactive sample is 160 Bq and the background activity at this location is 25% of the initial activity of the sample. The half-life of the radioactive nuclide is 7 hours.

What is the activity detected at the location of the sample after 21 hours?

  1. 25 Bq
  2. 40 Bq
  3. 60 Bq
  4. 80 Bq
